prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: parking lot collision in League City, Texas. Injury: wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1397; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant later added small details, but the account stayed the same.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was backing out of a parking space at a shopping center in League City, Texas, moving slowly, when another vehicle came down the lane and struck the rear corner of my car. I had checked my mirrors before reversing and I am confident the other driver was approaching faster than the posted pace. The impact threw me against the steering wheel and the door frame, and my left wrist took the brunt of it. I was taken to a clinic afterward, where the wrist was confirmed as fractured and placed in a splint. Since then I have recalled a few minor details about the moments before impact, such as the position of a shopping cart near the lane, but the core of my account has not changed from what I first reported. I am the named driver on the policy under which I am filing this claim.
